deals.summary: Microsoft's 10-Q discloses its funding commitments to OpenAI, which it accounts for under the equity method.
As part of its restructuring, OpenAI committed to buy additional Azure services from Microsoft.
SoftBank completed its investment commitment to OpenAI by sending a final tranche, giving it a stake of about 11%.
Under a letter of intent, Nvidia intends to invest in OpenAI as systems are deployed.
Letter of intent to deploy at least 10 GW of Nvidia systems for OpenAI, with the first phase in 2H 2026 on Vera Rubin.
OpenAI will deploy 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with MI450 in 2H 2026.
AMD granted OpenAI warrants for up to 160M AMD shares, about 10% of the company, vesting as GPU deployment milestones are met.
OpenAI and Broadcom will co-develop and deploy 10 GW of custom AI accelerators from 2026 to 2029.
OpenAI confirmed it signed a roughly five-year compute purchase from Oracle under Stargate, covering 4.5 GW and starting in 2027.
OpenAI signed an additional agreement with CoreWeave, with payment commitments running through April 2029, per a regulatory filing.
Meta signed a compute agreement with CoreWeave running to 2031.
Nvidia agreed to buy any CoreWeave cloud capacity left unsold through 2032.
Microsoft was CoreWeave's largest customer, with commitments reported through 2030.
Under a five-year GPU cloud contract, IREN hosts Nvidia GB300 capacity for Microsoft at Childress, Texas.
IREN buys Nvidia GB300 servers from Dell for the Microsoft contract.
Microsoft and Nebius have an AI compute deal.
Meta and Nebius signed a five-year AI infrastructure agreement.
Nebius entered definitive agreements for a private placement with participation from Accel, NVIDIA and Orbis-managed accounts.
Amazon is making an additional investment in Anthropic.
Google agreed to a new investment in Anthropic, confirmed to CNBC by an unnamed source.
Anthropic will use up to one million Google TPUs, over 1 GW of capacity, in 2026.
Microsoft will invest in Anthropic.
Nvidia will invest in Anthropic.
Anthropic's prospectus lists an expanded infrastructure deal with Microsoft running through May 2033, up from the earlier Azure commitment.
Seven-year AWS agreement for Nvidia GB200/GB300 capacity.
Reported six-year Google Cloud deal for Meta.
Oracle reportedly bought about 400,000 Nvidia GB200s for the Abilene, Texas Stargate site.
Nvidia invested in xAI's Series E, and the stake converted to SpaceX shares after the merger.
SK Hynix will supply HBM/DRAM for Stargate, as part of combined Korean supply deals over four years.
Samsung will supply HBM/DRAM for Stargate, as part of combined Korean supply deals over four years.
Talen supplies 1.92 GW from the Susquehanna nuclear plant to AWS through 2042.
Cipher and Fluidstack signed a 168 MW, 10-year AI hosting agreement.
CoreWeave signed two long-term leases at Applied Digital, for 100 MW and 150 MW blocks over about 15 years, with an option for a third 150 MW block.
CoreWeave leases the full 800 MW approved at Galaxy's Helios campus, Texas.
CoreWeave signed for 500 MW of Core Scientific data center capacity over 12 years.
AEP signed a supply agreement for up to 1 GW of Bloom fuel cells for AI data centers, with an initial 100 MW order placed and more expected in 2025.
SoftBank will buy shares from OpenAI employees in a tender offer, per CNBC sources.

Google signed a strategic partnership with Intersect Power and TPG Rise Climate to build colocated renewable power and storage with new US data centers, with Google as offtaker and anchor tenant; Google and TPG led an Intersect funding round.
Non-binding Master Power Agreement to deploy 12 GW of Oklo Aurora powerhouses through 2044 for Switch data centers via PPAs; binding agreements to follow at project milestones.
Nvidia took part as a strategic investor in xAI's Series C round.
AMD took part as a strategic investor in xAI's Series C round.
Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners and Google signed a PPA for 250 MW of renewable energy in the Netherlands.

Macquarie Asset Management will invest in Applied Digital's HPC subsidiary for a 15% stake, with initial funding for the 400MW Ellendale campus and a right of first refusal on further funding over 30 months.
Bloomberg reports HPE won a deal to build AI servers for X, finalized in late 2024 after competing with Dell and Supermicro; HPE did not comment.
Applied Digital's HPC subsidiary closed a financing with SMBC to repay the Macquarie Capital note and advance the Ellendale HPC Campus.
Bloomberg reported xAI is preparing to buy AI servers with Nvidia GB200 GPUs from Dell, to be delivered this year, citing unnamed sources.
As part of the five-year CoreWeave deal, OpenAI receives equity in CoreWeave.
Meta will buy 100% of the output of RWE's 200 MWac Waterloo Solar project in Texas under a long-term PPA.
AWS and HUMAIN announce a joint investment in AI infrastructure, AWS services, and AI training and talent development in Saudi Arabia and globally.
Multi-year partnership in which Supermicro supplies ultra-dense GPU platforms and rack-scale liquid cooling for DataVolt's AI campuses in Saudi Arabia and the US.
AMD signed a collaboration with HUMAIN to provide 500 MW of AI compute capacity for its data centers.
Humain will receive 18,000 Nvidia GB300 Blackwell chips for a 500 MW AI data center.
Two long-term PPAs for 650 MW of solar projects in Texas and Kansas (SPP market) support Meta's data centers.
A J.P. Morgan-led consortium provided a construction loan, arranged by Newmark, for phase two of the Crusoe/Blue Owl/Primary Digital JV's 1.2 GW AI data center in Abilene, Texas.
Meta invests in Scale AI for a 49% non-voting stake and hires CEO Alexandr Wang.
Nebius will deploy around 9,000 Nvidia Blackwell B300 GPUs at Ark's Longcross Park campus in Surrey, its first UK entry, starting with about 4,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs.
CoreWeave will buy Core Scientific to meet AI power needs.
Hydro Framework Agreement for Google to procure up to 3,000 MW of hydroelectric power from Brookfield, starting with a 20-year supply from the Holtwood and Safe Harbor plants.
Founders Fund is reported to be committing to OpenAI's funding round.
Dragoneer is reported to be committing to OpenAI's funding round.
Samsung will supply Tesla with AI and autonomous driving chips under a contract effective July 26, 2025 through Dec 31, 2033, confirmed by Musk.
Nvidia and YTL Power signed a strategic collaboration to use Nvidia GPUs to build AI data centers in Malaysia, plus a Malaysian sovereign LLM.
Meta picked Pimco to lead debt financing for the Hyperion data center in Louisiana, which Meta leases under a 20-year lease with a guarantee.
Blue Owl contributes equity to the Hyperion joint venture.
SoftBank recently closed a separate purchase of OpenAI employee shares.

Blue Owl funds, Chirisa Technology Parks and Machine Investment Group closed a joint venture to fund CoreWeave's Lancaster, PA developments, which CoreWeave will lease; Blue Owl intends to fund further CTP developments.
Macquarie Group led Fermi America's Series C preferred equity round for the HyperGrid AI private grid campus.
Macquarie's Commodities and Global Markets business solely funded a senior loan facility, with part of it drawn at close.
CoreWeave signed a new lease at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 2, increasing the total anticipated contracted lease revenue between the two.
Nscale and Aker agreed to a five-year AI compute capacity arrangement from 2026 at a data center in Kvandal, Norway.
OpenAI and CoreWeave expanded their existing agreement with a new expansion.
Aker committed cash and in-kind Narvik land to Nscale's Series B round, in exchange for 9.3% ownership.
Nvidia said it has invested in UK data center startup Nscale.

The BlackRock/GIP-led AI Infrastructure Partnership, with Nvidia, Microsoft, MGX and others, will buy Aligned Data Centers from Macquarie Asset Management, with close expected 1H 2026 subject to regulatory approvals.
Bloomberg reports Nvidia will invest in AI startup Poolside.
Fermi America entered a long-term capital lease with Mobile Power Solutions for seven GE TM2500 gas turbines totaling 157.5 MW, delivered Q4 2025.
Long-term PPA for 100 MW of solar energy in Grant County, Arkansas.
Anthropic made a compute commitment of initially up to 1 GW on Nvidia Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin systems.
Anthropic announced a commitment with Fluidstack days before the Microsoft deal, with details only mentioned in passing.
Schneider Electric partnered with Switch on power modules and cooling systems.
Schneider Electric agreed to supply Digital Realty with UPS and switchgear.
TPG is investing in HyperVault, TCS's AI data center business.

NIPSCO Generation will build up to 3 GW of gas generation and storage for Amazon data centers in northern Indiana under a 15-year deal paid for by Amazon; power starts Jan 1, 2027, rising to 2.4 GW by end of 2032.
Crusoe is launch customer for Boom's Superpower natural gas turbines, ordering 29 units totaling 1.21 GW for AI data centers.
NextEra and Google Cloud will develop at least three gigawatt-scale data center campuses with associated generation, and Google Cloud will provide AI services to NextEra.
Hut 8 signed a 15-year, 245 MW IT lease at its River Bend campus in Louisiana, with renewal options and a right of first offer on up to 1,000 MW more.
Google provides a financial backstop covering Fluidstack's obligations for the 15-year base lease term at River Bend.
WhiteFiber signed a 10-year, 40 MW colocation agreement at its NC-1 campus in Madison, North Carolina.
Alphabet will buy data center and power developer Intersect Power.
Nvidia will buy the assets of AI chip designer Groq for cash, per the CEO of Disruptive, which led Groq's last round.
SoftBank will acquire data center investment firm DigitalBridge.
Cisco Investments joined xAI's Series E as a strategic investor supporting its compute buildout.
Valor Compute Infrastructure raised funding, including from Apollo funds, to buy Nvidia GPUs and lease data center infrastructure to xAI under a triple net lease.
Cerebras and OpenAI struck a multi-year compute deal, confirmed by Cerebras's CEO.
Nvidia is making another investment in CoreWeave.
Meta committed to buy fiber-optic cable from Corning through 2030 for its AI data centers, including Prometheus and Hyperion.
Tesla agreed to invest in xAI Series E Preferred Stock as part of its financing round.
Clearway signed new long-term PPAs of up to 20 years with Google for nearly 1.2 GW of carbon-free energy from projects in Missouri, Texas and West Virginia.
SpaceX acquired xAI, combining the two private firms ahead of a planned IPO.
Nvidia is investing in OpenAI's funding round.
Dragoneer co-led Anthropic's Series G round; its individual amount was not stated.
Founders Fund co-led Anthropic's Series G round; its individual amount was not stated.
Blackstone is increasing its stake in Anthropic, per a source.
Two 15-year solar PPAs totaling 1 GW, at Wichita and Mustang Creek in Texas, will supply Google data centers, with construction from Q2 2026.
MUFG committed an equipment loan to fund three Siemens Energy gas turbines and repay a prior loan for Fermi America's campus.
Marvell will acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal, with close expected 1H 2028.
HUMAIN invested in xAI's Series E, and its holdings later converted into SpaceX shares after the merger.
Amazon completed its OpenAI investment in stages, in Q1, Q2 and after June 30, per an SEC filing.
SoftBank closed the third and final tranche of its OpenAI commitment, funded by a bond sale.
Meta and AMD signed a definitive multi-year, multi-generation agreement for Meta to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, starting with custom MI450 in 2H 2026.
AMD issued Meta a performance-based warrant for up to 160M AMD shares, vesting with GPU shipment milestones and stock price thresholds.
Baker Hughes secured a 1.21 GW generator order to power Boom Supersonic's AI data center solution.
Meta reportedly struck a deal with Google to access Google's TPU AI hardware, with terms not given.
OpenAI expanded its AWS agreement over eight years, including at least 2 GW of Trainium compute.
Nvidia is investing in Lumentum for US R&D and fab expansion, with a multi-year agreement including purchase commitments and future capacity access rights for laser components.
Nvidia is investing in Coherent for US R&D and fab expansion, with a multiyear agreement including purchase commitments and capacity rights for laser and optical networking products.
Nvidia will invest in Nebius as part of a strategic partnership to build gigawatt-scale AI factories.
New five-year agreement for dedicated capacity including Nvidia Vera Rubin from early 2027, plus options for additional capacity purchases.
A consortium led by BlackRock-owned GIP and EQT will take AES private, with close expected late 2026 or early 2027.
Nscale will acquire AIPCorp, developer of the 8+ GW Monarch Compute Campus in West Virginia.
Microsoft joins the additional tranche of OpenAI's funding round.
TPG participates in OpenAI's additional funding commitment, according to CFO Sarah Friar.
Sharon AI signs a five-year cloud capacity agreement and deploys 8,000 GPUs in an Australian data center.
Morgan Stanley, MUFG, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan arrange a non-recourse delayed draw term loan maturing 2032, anchored by Blackstone Credit and secured by GPU clusters and Meta contracted revenue.
CoreWeave and its customer expand their long-term AI cloud capacity agreement through December 2032, building on an earlier deal.
Jane Street signs an AI cloud deal with CoreWeave and increases its stake in the company.
Bloomberg reports Anthropic reached a deal with Broadcom; terms were not given.
Marvell completed its purchase of Celestial AI in the first quarter of 2026.
Amazon invests in Anthropic now, with further investment tied to commercial milestones, adding to its earlier investments.
Anthropic commits to a 10-year deal on AWS, including Trainium chips, securing up to 5 GW of capacity.
Jane Street bought CoreWeave equity alongside its compute deal.
DataBank secured construction financing from banks led by MUFG for three Red Oak, Texas data center buildings leased by a hyperscaler.
SpaceX exercised its option and bought Anysphere (Cursor) in an all-stock deal that closed August 14, 2026.
Boost Run signed a purchase agreement with Dell for enterprise AI compute and storage hardware and software, with financing via Dell Financial Services.
Google will invest in Anthropic, with an initial tranche now and the remainder contingent on performance milestones.
An amended IPO filing raises Google's commitment compared with the first filing.
Anan will establish and operate a 40 MW server farm for Crusoe in Afula, Israel, with plans to expand.
MARA Holdings will buy Long Ridge Energy as part of an AI data center push.
Nvidia gets a five-year option to buy up to 30M IREN shares, tied to a partnership to deploy up to 5 GW of AI infrastructure, mainly at Sweetwater, Texas.
IREN will provide Nvidia managed GPU cloud services for internal AI workloads at Childress, Texas, under a five-year contract.
Akamai and Anthropic signed a seven-year cloud infrastructure deal, Akamai's largest customer agreement ever.
Nvidia and Corning signed a pact allowing Nvidia to invest in Corning via stock warrants.
Nvidia invested in Marvell as part of a strategic partnership on silicon photonics.
Google signed a 15-year power purchase agreement for 500 MW from Linea's new Duffy Solar Project in Matagorda, Texas, supporting its ERCOT data centers.
New power purchase agreements signed in 2026 total 850 MW (500 MW Oklahoma, 200 MW Texas, 150 MW Mississippi); the partnership totals about 2,575 MW across nine states.
Blackstone will invest equity in a new AI infrastructure company with Google, which supplies TPUs, with the first 500 MW online by 2027.
Anthropic's IPO prospectus says amended SpaceX/xAI compute agreements run through 2029, and either party can exit on 90 days' notice after lock-ins end in January and March 2027.
Nebius signed a deal with Bloom Energy; details were not given in the headline.
Solar power purchase agreement for 200 MW AC from the Solstice project in LeFlore County, Oklahoma, to support Google data centers.
Apollo-managed funds lead an initial capital solution in Broadcom's AI XPV Platform with Blackstone and banks, supporting Anthropic's compute expansion of more than 1 GW starting mid-2026.

Google will pay SpaceX monthly from October 2026 through June 2029 for about 110,000 Nvidia GPUs plus CPUs and memory in SpaceX/xAI data centers, with capacity ramping through September at a reduced fee, per a SpaceX filing.
Stark Power entered a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Sagebrush Infrastructure Partners, developer of five hyperscale data center campuses (about 5.6 GW) with co-located gas power plants.
Google backstops lease payments tied to five US data centers Anthropic plans to use, underpinning the financing.
Reflection AI pays SpaceX monthly from July 1, 2026 through 2029 for access to Nvidia GB300 systems at Colossus.
Meta contracted about 1.6 GW of AI compute from Crusoe at its Childress and Warrenton sites, per Bloomberg.

Realty Income will invest, funded over time, for a 45% stake in a three-asset Northern Virginia hyperscale data center portfolio through a joint venture with Cloud Capital and a global institutional investor.

National Grid Ventures will invest for a 35% stake in Joulent, which develops Project Kilby, a 2.67 GW co-located power facility in West Texas with Chevron; final investment decision is expected in 2026.
Microsoft signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Chevron subsidiary Energy Forge One for a co-located natural gas power facility powering its new 2 GW Pecos, Texas data center campus.
A 20-year lease covers a purpose-built AI campus at TeraWulf's Hawesville, Kentucky site, with about 401 MW of critical IT load, online from the second half of 2027.
TeraWulf sold its 50.1% stake in the Abernathy joint venture, a 168 MW Texas facility, to a Fluidstack-led investor group.
Nebius confirmed a compute deal through 2029 giving Reflection access to Nvidia GB300 clusters.
AMD will invest in Anthropic alongside an AI server deal.
Anthropic will deploy 2 GW of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs in Helios racks, with the first GW in the first half of 2027.
Bloom Energy will supply behind-the-meter fuel cell systems for a Nebius AI cloud data center development backed by Industrial Development Funding and Oaktree.
UniTest signed a supply agreement with SK Hynix for HBM4 wafer test equipment.

sources.source: THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media

deals.summary: Verizon will provide dark fiber connecting Google's data centers, disclosed on its second-quarter call.
Nvidia and SK Group signed letters of intent for a strategic relationship including long-term HBM supply and SK Telecom's 2 GW Nvidia-based AI data center.
A five-year memorandum of understanding through 2030 covers HBM supply, foundry and advanced packaging.
Nvidia will invest in Naver, which is building GPU data centers with 200 MW of capacity.
Naver signed a contract with Brookfield for computing infrastructure funding for its AI factory.
Anthropic's CEO confirmed a supply deal with Samsung at the summit; terms were not given.
Anthropic's CEO confirmed a supply deal with SK Hynix at the summit; terms were not given.
Reuters, citing a source, reports Nvidia will invest in Ilya Sutskever's AI startup.
BlackRock-managed funds take 80% of a Meta venture developing the 1 GW El Paso, Texas data center campus, with Meta keeping 20%, partly debt-financed, and Meta receiving a distribution.
The FT reported Nvidia entered lease agreements for Hut 8's 1 GW Beacon Point campus in Texas, with a 15-year base contract, and plans to lease the compute to neocloud providers.
Morgan Stanley leads a bank group on bridge loan and revolver financing for Nexus Data Centers' Hubbard, Texas AI campus for Anthropic, in advanced talks.
Google backstops Anthropic's obligations on four data-center leases and related power agreements underpinning the Hubbard, Texas financing, and is expected to receive about 20% equity in the project.
Anthropic reportedly signed a six-year compute deal with Volta for a 133 MW Norway data center built with Bitdeer, running on Nvidia Vera Rubin systems.
A 16-year colocation lease at Bitdeer's Tydal, Norway campus, with an optional 8-year extension, covers 133 MW of gross capacity.
A 20-year lease covers 191 MW at Riot's Rockdale, Texas campus through June 2048, with extension options.
Morgan Stanley provides an interim financing facility to fund early development and long-lead equipment at Riot's Rockdale data center campus.
IBM to provide Together AI dedicated AI computing capacity on IBM Cloud using Nvidia HGX B300 systems, rolling out around Q1 2027.
Nvidia is a strategic investor in River AI's funding round.
AMD Ventures is a strategic investor in River AI's funding round.
JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs underwrote a term loan to Volta.
Nvidia to provide financing for OpenAI's Ohio data center, initially 4.25 GW with an option for 3.75 GW more, coming online in phases from 2028.
Nvidia to invest in SB Energy as part of the Ohio OpenAI data center deal.
SB Energy builds and manages the PORTS-Pike campus in Ohio, leased to OpenAI for 20 years.
AMD is the first tenant at Riot's Rockdale data center campus under a 10-year agreement with three five-year extensions.
Nvidia made a strategic investment in Lancium and will collaborate to deploy Nvidia AI infrastructure across Lancium's gigawatt-scale campuses.
Nscale's S-1 shows a deal with Anthropic that still needs binding financing for GPUs and data-center infrastructure.
Woodman placed a purchase order for Nvidia B300 GPU server clusters for its Yokohama AI project, with delivery by mid-November 2026.

Blue Owl-managed funds led a compute equipment financing for IREN, made up of a senior secured term loan and senior secured notes, to buy Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs for the Mackenzie campus in British Columbia, drawn in tranches.
Anthropic's S-1 lists a deal with Lambda running until 2034, and Lambda must secure its facility lease in a timely manner.
Fervo's Cape Station in Utah will supply 396 MW of geothermal power under a PPA for a potential Google data center, online 2028, with an option to expand by about 600 MW by June 2030.
Nvidia to buy Hugging Face, with additional equity set aside for employee retention; close expected in the first half of 2027.
SLB to acquire data-center thermal management firm Kelvion from Apollo and Triton-advised funds for cash plus assumed debt.
Nscale and Figure formed a multi-year partnership with an initial compute commitment that scales up, using up to 100,000 Nvidia GPUs, with first deployment in 2H 2027 in Barstow, Texas.
Qualcomm issued Amazon warrants for 25 million shares, expiring September 2036, vesting in tranches tied to commercial arrangements and Amazon purchases.
Data center infrastructure partnership in which warrant vesting is tied to Amazon and AWS purchases of Qualcomm server chips and other technology.
Verizon signed a supply agreement with Corning for over 80 million miles of optical fiber through 2032, for broadband and AI backbone networks.
The Information reports Anthropic struck a compute deal with Trump-linked Rum Group; no terms beyond the headline.
RWE signed a virtual PPA with Oracle for 433 MW from its existing Panther Creek I, II and III wind farms in West Texas, supporting Oracle's data center operations.
New Era Energy & Digital secured a 20-year, 207 MW PPA with Vistra.
Akamai announced a multi-year agreement with Anthropic for cloud computing capacity.
Akamai grants Anthropic a warrant for up to a 5% stake alongside the cloud computing deal.
20-year PPA with Constellation for 690 MW from the Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant, including a 190 MW uprate coming online 2030-2032, plus a related retail supply agreement.
Broadcom agreed to lend Anthropic funds via a convertible note to pay for infrastructure, per Anthropic's IPO prospectus.
Anthropic disclosed five-year equipment leases involving Broadcom and financing entities.

BofA, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley announced an SPV financing to buy Broadcom XPUs and networking to lease to Anthropic; Blackstone is sole second-lien provider and Broadcom gives residual value support.
FT reports Oracle cancelled the five-year lease of up to 100,000 AI chips to Tencent in Southeast Asian data centers after US officials raised concerns; neither company confirmed.
Multi-year deal in which Amazon licenses Synopsys IP and expands EDA tool use for AI chip design, while Synopsys adopts Bedrock and AWS compute.
Oracle to pay for 125 to 250 MW of power that We Energies buys from the Point Beach nuclear plant, for its southeastern Wisconsin data centers.
20-year PPA for 890 MW from upgraded Constellation nuclear plants in PJM, enabling new Constellation investment.
Separate long-term supply agreement for 2,700 MW from Constellation's existing plants in PJM, not tied to a specific source (15 years per other reports).
Alphabet to directly finance a 564 MW natural gas and microgrid expansion by Black Hills in Cheyenne, Wyoming, including refundable advances; the contract runs to 2048.
Five-year agreement for GlobalFoundries to produce silicon interposers for TSMC's CoWoS packaging in the US, with volume ramp in 1H 2028.
Brookfield's financing framework for Bloom Energy was expanded to convert AI data center interest into financed projects.
Apollo anchors Volta's debt deal for a Norway data center.
Mainspring to provide up to 1.6 GW of linear generators to AEP through 2034, with a first tranche of 190 MW delivering from 2027.
JPMorgan and MUFG arranged senior secured construction financing for two Vantage data center campuses, in Texas and Wisconsin, linked to Oracle's expansion.
Nvidia gives KYEC a capacity reservation advance to build new US chip-testing facilities, with high-volume production targeted for April 2027.
Market chatter: Nvidia and Tesla plan a combined investment in Samsung Electro-Mechanics; split not stated.
Market chatter: Tesla and Nvidia plan a combined investment in Samsung Electro-Mechanics; split not stated.
Verizon signed an AI infrastructure deal with AWS; details limited to the headline.
SpaceX signed an equipment-finance lease with Apollo to pay for Nvidia GPUs for xAI, in tranches with lease schedules of about five years.
36-month reservation of Nvidia B300 GPU capacity at Forum Edge's Dallas facility.
Canada to take an equity stake in Cohere; Cohere commits to jobs and to investing in Canadian computing infrastructure by 2030.
AMD to invest in Meta's equity offering as the partnership covering up to 6 GW expands.
USD.AI led and closed a four-year senior secured term loan for NexGen Cloud to finance 1,728 Nvidia B300 GPUs in Finland, with Silver Point and Victory Park as lenders.
Nebius announced a 364-day bridge loan from Citi, with the rate stepping up every 90 days.
GE Vernova to buy high-voltage grid equipment maker Trench Group from Triton Partners.
Nvidia in talks to guarantee Nscale debt for the 460 MW West Virginia site for Anthropic; nothing signed.
Nvidia invests in Meta's share sale, part of Meta's equity raise to fund its AI infrastructure build.
AMD is reportedly effectively guaranteeing a loan so Crusoe can buy AMD chips, per The Information.
KB Kookmin Bank is lead arranger for syndicated loans to a Brookfield SPC buying GPUs and AI infrastructure to supply Naver Cloud, as part of a larger project.
Capital Power entered a long-term energy supply agreement with Meta for 250 MW of capacity and energy supporting a Meta data centre in Alberta.
Qualcomm Ventures joined Hark's Series A round.
Nvidia joined Hark's Series A round.
AMD joined Hark's Series A round.
Barber Lake lease extended to 20 years, combining an amended Fluidstack lease with a 10-year commitment from an AI lab.
Vistra will be preferred power supplier to Helix Digital Infrastructure, backed by KKR, KIA and Nvidia, and committed funding to it.
Drax, Brookfield and Radiant will develop a 1 GW+ AI data centre at Drax Power Station in North Yorkshire, with a first phase of up to 100MW.
Intel Capital joined Hark's funding round alongside Nvidia and AMD Ventures; its individual amount was not stated.
Micron is the sole subscriber of GlobalWafers' 10-year convertible bonds, alongside a 10-year long-term supply agreement.
Xcel Energy and Google announced the 780 MW Project Skyway data center plan, tying new grid investments to AI computing needs.
Amazon provides Anthropic a funding facility drawn as AWS delivers compute, with a large portion still undrawn at June 30.
X-energy and AEP signed a joint development agreement for a proposed 12-unit, 960 MW Xe-100 plant in Sullivan County, Indiana.
Amazon will help fund development of the 960 MW X-energy/AEP Indiana plant and plans to buy the power.
Williams has a 400 megawatt power deal with Meta, credited for its optimistic guidance.
Applied Materials is doubling its stake in Besi to about 20% and partners with it on hybrid bonding.
Pinnacle West expects to file with the Arizona regulator a 25-year power deal to supply TSMC 1.88 GW.
Eaton agreed to acquire COL Group, expanding European manufacturing and power distribution for data center and utility markets.
Eaton acquired Boyd Thermal.
Google signed three credit support agreements backstopping Anthropic's 20-year, roughly 401 MW leases at TeraWulf's Hawesville, Kentucky campus, effective once data halls commence.

Soluna and Applied Digital will form a JV for a 50 MW AI/HPC data center at Dorothy 3, Briscoe County, Texas; Applied Digital owns 51% and funds development, while Soluna contributes land and power assets, subject to approvals including a county tax abatement.
Core Scientific will provide 529 MW of data-center capacity; AMD leased 377 MW itself and backed a cloud provider taking 152 MW, letting AMD secure up to 2.5 GW for customers.
AMD received warrants to buy up to 30M Core Scientific shares, with rights increasing as more capacity is leased.
Bloomberg reports Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance ordered about 6M Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 chips combined, but expect to receive only a small fraction soon.
AMD entered a definitive cash-and-stock agreement to acquire Taalas, a developer of specialized inference silicon, including some contingent payments.
The Department of Energy gave Constellation a conditional loan commitment to expand nuclear output.
An AI lab, reportedly Anthropic per a CoinDesk headline, signed a 15-year lease with Riot for 910 MW of IT capacity.
A 20-year power purchase agreement covers a 702 MW Bloom fuel-cell project with carbon capture near Cheyenne, Wyoming, in which AEP plans to invest.
Nvidia agreed to guarantee some of Nscale's obligations under the Ionic lease in return for warrants, per Nscale's S-1.
Statements of work signed from September 2025 to April 2026 run through December 2033, subject to delivery requirements; Microsoft declined an option to expand the Texas contract.
Digital Realty and Goodman's jointly owned trust made an offer for up to 9.9% of NEXTDC shares; fill and payment are not confirmed.
Core Scientific closed its acquisition of Polaris DS, expanding its HPC and AI data center footprint.
NTT DATA agreed with Bloom Energy to deploy 900 MW of onsite fuel cell power across multiple global data center projects, designed to expand toward gigawatt scale.
